race.comment: Wide open edition of the Moonee Valley Cup. AETHELWULF (12) and JUJA KIBO (2) come through The Metropolitan and get the visitor's draws. AETHELWULF started $2.80 favourite there, going back to the fence perhaps wasn't ideal and the tempo was very slow. JUJA KIBO was very good coming from just off the speed with a devastating turn of foot to win well. If AETHELWULF is still holding his form deep into the campaign he can turn the tables. PINHOLE (3) is a huge threat off a big win in the G2 Herbert Power, well backed in a driving finish. J-Mac sticks from a lovely middle gate and he's still on an upward spiral. Very wary of KING PEDRO (11) who had a setback leading into the Spring where he was early favourite for The Metropolitan. His return in the G2 Hill Stakes was a beauty, Lane on from a soft draw, just wonder if he's half a run short for this. MR MONACO (7) sat outside a moderate speed and won the G3 Bart Cummings nicely last time. Probably ridden colder here however.
